# AllWebsites.Design

> A curated website-design research archive. Study real websites by industry, style, colour, typography and technology — then use free in-browser colour tools that share the same language.

AllWebsites.Design publishes constructed, source-verified records. We do not invent missing facts: unproven technology or design fields stay unknown. The official destination of each site remains the authority.

Canonical site: https://www.allwebsites.design

## Discover

- [Home](https://www.allwebsites.design/): Overview of the archive, tools and categories
- [Archive](https://www.allwebsites.design/archive): Search and filter every published website record
- [Categories](https://www.allwebsites.design/c): Browse website design by industry
- [2026 Website Design Index](https://www.allwebsites.design/research/website-design-index-2026): Transparent snapshot of catalogue composition
- [Journal](https://www.allwebsites.design/blogs): Notes on colour, typography and technology

## Tools

Free, no-signup design instruments. Each owns one job and runs in the browser.

- [Chromary](https://www.allwebsites.design/tools/chromary): Color name finder and dictionary
- [Colorhyme](https://www.allwebsites.design/tools/colorhyme): Hue-shift and colour transformer
- [WebPalette Studio](https://www.allwebsites.design/tools/webpalette): Role-based website palette builder
- [Mockupalettes](https://www.allwebsites.design/tools/mockupalettes): Preview a 4-colour palette on a website mockup
- [TrueGradient](https://www.allwebsites.design/tools/truegradient): Compare sRGB and OKLCH gradient interpolation
- [All tools](https://www.allwebsites.design/tools): Toolkit overview

## Records

Website records live at `/archive/<slug>` (for example https://www.allwebsites.design/archive/rankbeaver). Each record can include identity, category, palette, typography, detected technology, screenshots and similar sites. Prefer the official URL on the record over archive commentary.

Category pages live at `/c/<category-slug>`.
